taskVersion.name: ves-real-item

parts.text:
You are a hydrogeologist preparing site notes for a borehole drilling team.

Station Egwi (Etche LGA survey stations). Interpreted VES layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 295.88 | 0.54518 | 0.54518
2 | 798.6 | 3.5924 | 4.1376
3 | 864.62 | 2.1559 | 6.2935
4 | 1810.2 | 37.957 | 37.25
5 | 5634.2 | - | -

The survey interpretation on file classifies this sounding curve as HAA-type.

Write the site note using exactly this template:

Station: <station name>
Curve type: <VES curve type>
Aquifer depth: <depth range in m>
Recommendation: <one or two sentences for the drilling team>

Station: Egwi
Curve type: HAA-type
Aquifer depth: 6.29 m – 37.25 m (Layer 4: moderately high resistivity sand/sandstone unit underlying the near-surface layers and overlying the resistive basement)
Recommendation: Target drilling to approximately 38–40 m, casing off the upper low-to-moderate resistivity layers (0–6.3 m) and setting well screens within the 6.29–37.25 m interval; terminate drilling once the highly resistive basal layer (>5600 ohm-m, inferred basement/compact formation) is encountered, as it is unlikely to be water-bearing.
